notes.note: Row and page action on an IPAM address: open the dialog that reserves it in DHCP.
Row action on a lease that is not a reservation: open the dialog that reserves the address for the client.
Row action on a lease that is the client's reservation: open the reserved host's page.
Toast when the reserved host of a lease could not be read.

segment.source: The reserved host could not be read.
segment.target: Den reserverade värden kunde inte läsas.

notes.note: Title of the dialog that reserves an address in DHCP.
While the dialog reads the address, the scope and the lease.

segment.source: Reading the address, its scope and its lease…
segment.target: Läser adressen, dess omfång och dess lån…

notes.note: Confirmation after the save.
Confirmation when the reservation was in place already and nothing changed.

segment.source: {ip} was reserved for {host} already; nothing changed.
segment.target: {ip} var redan reserverad för {host}; inget ändrades.

notes.note: Link to the reserved host's page after the save.
The address lies in a network without a DHCP scope.

segment.source: No DHCP scope serves the network of {ip}: create the scope first, then reserve the address.
segment.target: Inget DHCP-omfång betjänar nätet för {ip}: skapa omfånget först och reservera sedan adressen.

notes.note: The scope of the address serves clients.

segment.source: The address lies in the scope {cidr}, which this server serves.
segment.target: Adressen ligger i omfånget {cidr}, som den här servern betjänar.

notes.note: The scope of the address is disabled.

segment.source: The address lies in the scope {cidr}, which is disabled: the reservation is written now and served once the scope is enabled.
segment.target: Adressen ligger i omfånget {cidr}, som är avstängt: reservationen skrivs nu och betjänas när omfånget slås på.

notes.note: The scope is enabled, but the dhcp role of this server does not answer.

segment.source: The address lies in the scope {cidr}; the dhcp role of this server does not serve it at the moment.
segment.target: Adressen ligger i omfånget {cidr}; DHCP-rollen på den här servern betjänar det inte just nu.

notes.note: Link to the scope page.
Label: the address to reserve.
Help of the address field when the dialog was opened from a lease.

segment.source: The lease's address, or another address of the same network.
segment.target: Lånets adress, eller en annan adress i samma nät.

notes.note: The typed address is outside the scope's network.

segment.source: {ip} lies outside the network {cidr} of the lease's scope.
segment.target: {ip} ligger utanför nätet {cidr} för lånets omfång.

notes.note: The address lies inside a DHCP pool; IPAM refuses a reservation there.

segment.source: {ip} lies in the DHCP pool {first}–{last}. IPAM keeps reservations out of the pools: move the address out of the pool, or shrink the pool, before you reserve it.
segment.target: {ip} ligger i DHCP-poolen {first}–{last}. IPAM håller reservationer utanför poolerna: flytta adressen ut ur poolen, eller krymp poolen, innan du reserverar den.

notes.note: The lease's address lies inside a DHCP pool; the dialog offers another address.

segment.source: {ip} lies in the DHCP pool {first}–{last}. IPAM keeps reservations out of the pools: reserve an address outside the pool for this client. It keeps its lease until it ends and then gets the reserved address.
segment.target: {ip} ligger i DHCP-poolen {first}–{last}. IPAM håller reservationer utanför poolerna: reservera en adress utanför poolen för klienten. Den behåller sitt lån tills det går ut och får sedan den reserverade adressen.

notes.note: Button: use the next free address outside the pools.
Label: the host the reservation belongs to.
An existing host in the host menu, with its assignment mode.
Menu entry: create a new host.
Label: the name of the new host.
Label: the interface of the host that gets the identity.
Menu entry: create a new interface on the host.
Label: the name of the new interface.
Label: the MAC address of the client.
Help of the MAC address field.

segment.source: Prefilled from the interface, the lease on the address or what discovery saw.
segment.target: Ifylld från gränssnittet, lånet på adressen eller det som upptäckten såg.

notes.note: Label: the DHCP client identifier (option 61), optional.
Help of the client identifier field.

segment.source: Option 61 in hexadecimal. When set, the reservation is keyed by it instead of the MAC address; leave it empty to key by the MAC address.
segment.target: Alternativ 61 i hexadecimal form. När den är satt nycklas reservationen på den i stället för på MAC-adressen; lämna fältet tomt för att nyckla på MAC-adressen.

notes.note: Legend of the status choice of the address.
Address status: active.
Address status: planned.
Assignment mode of a host: static.
Assignment mode of a host: reserved.
Assignment mode of a host: dynamic.
Assignment mode of a host: unmanaged.
Heading of the sentences that say what the save changes.

segment.target: Det här ändras när du sparar

notes.note: After a 412: an object changed while the dialog was open.

segment.source: Close the dialog and open it again to start from what IPAM holds now.
segment.target: Stäng dialogen och öppna den igen för att utgå från det IPAM har nu.

notes.note: Button: write the reservation.
The typed address is not an IP address.

segment.source: Enter an IP address such as 192.0.2.20.

notes.note: The name of the new host is not a valid host name.

segment.source: Enter a host name of letters, digits and hyphens, such as printer01.
segment.target: Ange ett värdnamn av bokstäver, siffror och bindestreck, till exempel printer01.

notes.note: The name of the new interface is empty.

segment.source: Enter a name for the interface, such as eth0.
segment.target: Ange ett namn på gränssnittet, till exempel eth0.

notes.note: The MAC address does not parse.
The client identifier is not hexadecimal.
Neither a MAC address nor a client identifier is known (IPAM-18).

segment.source: A reservation needs a MAC address or a client identifier.
segment.target: En reservation behöver en MAC-adress eller en klientidentifierare.

notes.note: Preview: the reservation is in place already.

segment.source: Everything is in place already: the save changes nothing.
segment.target: Allt är redan på plats: inget ändras när du sparar.

notes.note: Preview: a new host is created.

segment.source: A new host {name} is created, of mode reserved.
segment.target: En ny värd {name} skapas, med läget reserverad.

notes.note: Preview: an existing host becomes reserved.
Preview: the host is reserved already.
Preview: a new interface is created without a MAC address.

segment.source: A new interface {name} is created on the host.
segment.target: Ett nytt gränssnitt {name} skapas på värden.

notes.note: Preview: a new interface is created with a MAC address.

segment.source: A new interface {name} is created with the MAC address {mac}.
segment.target: Ett nytt gränssnitt {name} skapas med MAC-adressen {mac}.

notes.note: Preview: an interface without a MAC address gets one.
Preview: an interface's MAC address is replaced.

segment.source: Interface {name} gets the MAC address {mac} instead of {old}.
segment.target: Gränssnittet {name} får MAC-adressen {mac} i stället för {old}.

notes.note: Preview: the interface keeps its MAC address.
Preview: the interface gets a client identifier.
Preview: the interface's client identifier is removed.
Preview: IPAM does not hold the address yet; it is created.

segment.source: The address {ip} is created in IPAM on interface {name}, status {status}.
segment.target: Adressen {ip} skapas i IPAM på gränssnittet {name}, med status {status}.

notes.note: Preview: the address moves to the interface.

segment.source: The address {ip} is bound to interface {name}.

notes.note: Preview: the address keeps its status.
Preview: the address changes its status.
Preview: what the reservation is keyed by.

segment.source: The reservation is keyed by the MAC address {value}.

notes.note: Preview: what the reservation is keyed by.

segment.source: The reservation is keyed by the client identifier {value}.

notes.note: Preview: the scope serves the reservation.

segment.source: The scope {cidr} serves the reservation once the dhcp role has read the change.
segment.target: Omfånget {cidr} betjänar reservationen när DHCP-rollen har läst ändringen.

notes.note: Preview: the scope is disabled.

segment.source: The scope {cidr} is disabled: the reservation is served once the scope is enabled.
segment.target: Omfånget {cidr} är avstängt: reservationen betjänas när omfånget slås på.

notes.note: Preview: the dhcp role of this server does not serve.

segment.source: The dhcp role of this server does not serve {cidr} at the moment; the reservation waits for it.
segment.target: DHCP-rollen på den här servern betjänar inte {cidr} just nu; reservationen väntar på den.

notes.note: Preview: the lease on the address is held by another client than the one reserved.

segment.source: The lease on {ip} is held by {mac}, another client; it keeps the address until its lease ends.
segment.target: Lånet på {ip} hålls av {mac}, en annan klient; den behåller adressen tills lånet går ut.
